name: Bureaucrat
description:
You've seen the power of a highly formalized society in the Underdark.

You may invoke each of the following effects once per rest:

  • When an effect forces you to make a skill check, you may roll Courtesy instead of the stated skill.

  • When one of your abilities calls for a contest, you may roll Courtesy vs Courtesy instead of the stated skills.

  • You may request a pass/win with consequence from the GM even if your roll result does not include any successes. If the GM does not accept, this does not count toward the per-rest limit for this effect.

Describe how you weaponize formality.
